body:
The supplied compensated square had a formal rotor limit but no certified numerical error for its leading microscopic correction. This milestone derives its exact Schur reduction and the joint-scaling first correction, then bounds the first six gap errors for six explicitly specified finite-spin cases using rational inertia and infinite-tail sandwiches.

This is **bounded_theorem / conditional-support** under the supplied square law, fixed sector, integer spin and zero offset. It does not identify a physical spin, establish a uniform asymptotic remainder, retire imported premises, or improve the experimental residuals in PR9348. Detector/cavity extensions remain exploratory and outside this claim.

- [Self-contained note](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/measured-corrections-20260927/docs/SQUARE_MICROSCOPIC_SPECTRAL_CERTIFICATE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-27.md)
- [Primary runner](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/measured-corrections-20260927/scripts/square_microscopic_spectral_certificate_2026_09_27.py) and [authenticated output](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/measured-corrections-20260927/logs/runner-cache/square_microscopic_spectral_certificate_2026_09_27.txt)

- [Final source review](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/measured-corrections-20260927/.claude/science/physics-loops/measured-corrections-20260927/FINAL_SPECTRAL_PUBLICATION_REVIEW.md) and [review/conformance history](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/measured-corrections-20260927/.claude/science/physics-loops/measured-corrections-20260927/REVIEW_HISTORY.md)

Independent checks reconstruct the microscopic matrices, Schur/coefficient algebra, determinant-sign counts, tail bounds and interval rounding. The consolidated runner reproduces all six certificates; vocabulary, Python compilation, source hashes and diff checks pass. Injected bracket, hopping and positivity faults are detected. The citation manifest adds exactly one note and its two intended parent edges.

Full pipeline, strict audit lint and changed-evidence validation remain for the exact integrated current-main landing candidate. No audit verdict or retained promotion is asserted; no author merge is requested. Historical probes and failed calibration directions are preserved in the research packet with their scope limits. No editable prompts or skills changed.
